name: ramus-mcp
description: Read, see, check, edit and create Ramus models (.rsf) - IDEF0, DFD and DFDS - Claude's eyes and hands for Ramus.
long_description:
Claude opens a Ramus model, reads its activity tree and arrows, and sees each diagram as a picture. It checks the model against the rules of IDEF0 - controls and outputs on every box, ICOM balance between levels, 3 to 6 boxes on a sheet, verbs for activities and nouns for arrows - changes it, with boxes and arrows placed and routed the IDEF0 way, or builds a new model from nothing, and saves a .rsf that Ramus opens. Data flow diagrams in DFD and DFDS notation too. For a report it exports sheets to PNG or SVG in the IDEF0 diagram form, with boxes and arrows in the colours and line styles you ask for. It works on the file format itself: neither Ramus nor Java is needed.

Коннектор, через который Клод читает, рисует, проверяет по правилам IDEF0, правит и создаёт с нуля модели Ramus (.rsf) — IDEF0, DFD и DFDS, — и выгружает листы в бланке IDEF0 для отчёта.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Find the .rsf models in the models folder or another one.

tools.name: open_model
tools.description: Open a model to work on.

tools.description: Create a new model from nothing - IDEF0, DFD or DFDS: a context diagram with its top activity.

tools.name: current_model
tools.description: Say which model is open and whether it has unsaved changes.

tools.description: List the model's diagrams.

tools.name: get_function_tree
tools.description: The whole activity tree with IDEF0 numbers.

tools.name: get_diagram

tools.name: render_diagram
tools.description: One diagram drawn as a picture.

tools.name: render_diagram_svg_text
tools.description: One diagram as an SVG document.

tools.name: export_diagram
tools.description: Write diagrams to PNG or SVG files, in the IDEF0 diagram form - for a report.

tools.name: check_model
tools.description: Check the model against the rules of IDEF0, with the fix for each finding.

tools.name: check_layout
tools.description: Say how well a diagram is drawn: crossings, detours, arrow ends in corners, names astray.

tools.name: rename_activity
tools.description: Rename an activity.

tools.name: rename_flow
tools.description: Rename what an arrow carries, on every level.

tools.name: add_activity

tools.name: add_arrow

tools.name: add_text

tools.name: set_purpose

tools.name: layout_sheet
tools.description: Lay a diagram out afresh: boxes down the diagonal, every arrow drawn again.

tools.name: tidy_labels
tools.description: Move arrow names that are in the way.

tools.name: save_model
tools.description: Write the changes to the model file, or to a copy.
